name: Monte Carlo
summary: Random sampling was used on computers to solve deterministic problems.

name: Linear programming and simplex method
summary: An algorithm moving along vertices of a polyhedron solved linear programs efficiently.

name: Ramsey lower bounds from high-dimensional sphere geometry
summary: Colouring edges of a complete graph by distances between random points on a high-dimensional sphere gave the first improvement in about fifty years on Erdos's 1947 bound for near-diagonal Ramsey numbers.

name: Information theory
summary: Entropy and channel capacity were defined, with coding theorems for noisy communication.

name: Algebraic coding theory
summary: Error-correcting codes were built from algebra over finite fields.

name: Cellular automata and self-reproducing machines
summary: Von Neumann and Ulam model self-reproduction by lattice automata.

name: Kantorovich functional analysis for numerical methods
summary: Ordered vector spaces and normed spaces were applied to approximation and equation solving.

name: Feynman-Kac formula
summary: Path integrals matched with expectations over Brownian paths.

name: Lie algebra cohomology
summary: Cohomology of compact Lie groups was computed algebraically via Lie algebras.

name: Weil conjectures: topology enters arithmetic
summary: Counting points on varieties over finite fields is predicted to behave like Betti numbers, and a cohomology theory built for that purpose proves it.
